claim_tested: An Rco1-containing deacetylase complex exists in C. albicans
key_finding: Co-IP shows CaRco1 physically interacts with CaRpd31 but not CaRpd3; the authors name the assembly CaRpd31S
context: C. albicans SC5314 derivatives, epitope-tagged RCO1-9myc with RPD31-3HA or RPD3-3HA, in vivo
confidence_and_limitations: High for the positive interaction. Targeted two-protein co-IP, no stoichiometry, no demonstration that Eaf3 is in the same assembly

claim_tested: Eaf3 and Rco1 are absent from CaRpd3/CaRpd31 complexes
key_finding: The authors state they were unable to identify Eaf3 and Rco1 in the pulldowns; the method was a one-step anti-myc Dynabead IP in 10 mM Tris pH 8.0, 150 mM NaCl, 0.1% Na-deoxycholate, 10% SDS-PAGE, silver stain, visible bands excised for MS
confidence_and_limitations: Low as evidence of absence. Band-excision silver-stain MS detects only abundant subunits; only 5 interactors were recovered (Sin3 Dep1 Pho23 Rxt2 Ume1) and no gel-free shotgun of the whole lane was run

claim_tested: Which ScEaf3 MRG residues contact Rco1
key_finding: 120 contact pairs at 4.5 A, 50 Eaf3 residues (218-400 modelled), 45 Rco1 residues (258-375 modelled); author numbering matches UniProt with 0 mismatches
context: S. cerevisiae recombinant Eaf3-Rco1 with an H3 N-terminal peptide
confidence_and_limitations: High. Crystal contacts possible but 96% of the set is reproduced in two independent cryo-EM structures

claim_tested: Which ScEaf3 and ScRco1 residues form the interface in the intact complex
key_finding: 353 contact pairs, 74 ScEaf3 residues (72 in MRG 216-399; only E102 E103 in the chromodomain), 84 ScRco1 residues; Rco1 partition SID/inter-PHD 308-415 = 212 pairs, C-terminus >470 = 85, PHD1 262-307 = 51, PHD2 = 0
context: S. cerevisiae Rpd3S bound to nucleosome
confidence_and_limitations: High. Two independent depositions agree; resolution 2.8 and 3.46 A

claim_tested: The Rco1 SID region contacts Eaf3 and the contact is functionally required
key_finding: Mutations at the SID-Eaf3 interface do not disrupt complex integrity but severely compromise Rpd3S function in vitro and in vivo
context: S. cerevisiae, DXMS and reconstituted Rpd3S
confidence_and_limitations: High for S. cerevisiae. No C. albicans data

key_finding: Sin3 and two copies each of Rco1 and Eaf3 encircle Rpd3 and coordinate Ume1
confidence_and_limitations: High. Recombinant reconstitution, so native stoichiometry is inferred

claim_tested: The asymmetric Rco1-Eaf3 dimer architecture is conserved
key_finding: Asymmetrical Rco1-Eaf3 dimers coordinate nucleosome engagement and Pol II interaction; Rco1-PHD1 and Eaf3-CHD bind Ser5-phosphorylated Rpb1 CTD
confidence_and_limitations: High for yeast. The word conserved in the abstract is not supported there by Candida data

claim_tested: Eaf3 MRG conservation could reflect NuA4 rather than Rpd3S
key_finding: Eaf3 is shared between NuA4/TINTIN and Rpd3S and its MRG domain contacts Eaf7
context: S. cerevisiae reconstituted TINTIN, HDX-MS and AlphaFold2
confidence_and_limitations: High. This is the main alternative explanation for MRG surface conservation

claim_tested: Do Rco1 and Eaf7 use the same Eaf3 surface
key_finding: 46 Eaf3 residues contact Eaf7 (224-401); 38 of the 48 high-confidence Rco1-core residues (79%) are also Eaf7 contacts
confidence_and_limitations: High. Makes the Eaf3-side conservation argument non-discriminating

claim_tested: Is the Eaf3 Rco1-binding surface retained in C. albicans
key_finding: High-confidence core 29/48 identical (60.4%) vs 80/227 (35.2%) for the rest of the resolved surface, Fisher OR 2.80 p = 0.00183, 0 gaps; conserved aromatics W236 Y238 Y288 Y299 Y306
context: Q12432 vs Q59K07, global NW BLOSUM62 gap -11/-1, 36.0% identity overall
confidence_and_limitations: Moderate. Enrichment is clear but confounded by the Eaf7 site overlap

claim_tested: Is the Rco1 Eaf3-binding surface retained in C. albicans
key_finding: 0 of 84 Eaf3-contact positions deleted in CaRco1, against 12.3% deletion across the whole protein and 12.4% across resolved non-contact residues, Fisher p = 1.08e-4; identity 44.0% vs 35.1% background (p = 0.157)
confidence_and_limitations: Moderate to high. Rco1 is not a NuA4 subunit, so this constraint is unconfounded; indel depletion is the stronger signal, identity enrichment is not significant

claim_tested: Does C. albicans encode a single Rco1 ortholog with the needed domains
key_finding: A0A1D8PR21 (orf19.13859 / CAALFM_C702110WA, 688 aa) is the only CANAL member of IPR052819; NW score 455 against ScRco1 vs -2, -116, -228 for the other CANAL PHD proteins; PHD1 cd15535 at 272-314, PHD2 cd15534 at 411-459
context: C. albicans SC5314 reference proteome, taxonomy-filtered InterPro query
confidence_and_limitations: High. Domain boundaries are from CDD/InterPro models rather than a C. albicans structure

claim_tested: Is the Sin3-Rco1 scaffold intact in C. albicans
key_finding: 408 Sin3-Rco1 contact pairs; 91/129 Rco1-contacting Sin3 residues identical in CaSin3 (70.5%) with 0 gaps vs 63.9% for the rest of the resolved Sin3 surface (OR 1.35 p = 0.171); CaRco1 keeps ScRco1 109-129 entirely and PHD2 cysteines C420 C443 C451
context: P22579 vs A0A1D8PCC3 (52.3% identity over 1347) and Q04779 vs A0A1D8PR21
confidence_and_limitations: Moderate. High absolute conservation but no statistical enrichment over the Sin3 background

claim_tested: Which C. albicans HDAC paralog corresponds to ScRpd3
key_finding: CaRpd31 Q5ADP0 is 84.5% identical to ScRpd3 over 432 aligned residues; CaRpd3 A0A1D8PSA6 is 75.9% over 431
confidence_and_limitations: High for the numbers. Gene naming for these two paralogs conflicts between publications and databases

claim_tested: Does C. albicans have a complete Rpd3S parts list
key_finding: Single-copy SIN3 A0A1D8PCC3, UME1 A0A1D8PRH3, SET2 Q59XV0, RPD3 A0A1D8PSA6, RPD31 Q5ADP0, MRG family single member Q59K07, Rco1 family single member A0A1D8PR21
confidence_and_limitations: High. Presence of orthologs does not prove assembly

claim_tested: Does the CaEaf3 C-terminal shortening break the interface
key_finding: All 6 gapped contact positions (K377 D378 R381 S382 D384 M401) lie in one contiguous 10-residue deletion of ScEaf3 376-385 (DKDPNRSDDA) carrying 11 of 353 contact pairs; the remaining 68 align with no gaps
confidence_and_limitations: Moderate. A trimmed acidic rim with an intact buried core; energetic consequence not measured
